node.label: Michael B Katz
node.date_label: The Irony of Early School Reform (1968) · W.E.B. Du Bois, Race, and the City (co-edited with Thomas J. Sugrue) (1998) · The Price of Citizenship (updated edition) (2008)
node.description: A historian of education, cities and welfare who challenged moralized categories of poverty. His statements on poorhouses question the division between deserving and undeserving people and the belief that punitive institutions can eliminate dependence.
